lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits. The arrangement consists of multiple vertical columns, with three primary spots vertically aligned in the region directly above the pectoral fin attachment, transitioning to a more sparse distribution towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form a grid. High-luminance blobs are primarily localized within the centers of these rectangular grid cells rather than at the exact intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running parallel along the flank. Each ridge displays a sharp luminance gradient with peak intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and a narrow band of low-intensity pixels (shadow) on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible first dorsal fin contains approximately 10-14 small, high-luminance blobs. These are concentrated primarily on the lower half of the fin silhouette, with the density decreasing significantly towards the trailing edge and apex.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the first gill slit displays a high-density cluster of smaller, irregularly spaced high-luminance points that do not follow the grid-like organization found on the lateral flank.
